purpose: Official-source comparator for NYSC COURSE-019 Quantity Surveying Assistant. The governed catalogue publishes no module headings, so the record is shown without a competency matrix.
status_note: Source-inspected record awaiting independent human review; an occupational standard is not evidence of programme delivery.

country_group_gaps.developing_emerging: No additional specialist assistant-level quantity-surveying curriculum with inspectable official content was verified. Broader construction-estimating and civil-drafting programmes were excluded.
country_group_gaps.developed: No specialist assistant-level quantity-surveying qualification with sufficiently comparable occupational scope was verified. Higher-education quantity-surveying degrees and broad building qualifications were excluded.

records.institution: Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission / National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authority

modules.title_verbatim: Assist to prepare Bill of Quantities (BOQ)
Assist in estimating and tendering/bidding process
Assist to quantity surveying activities during post contract stage

source.publication_or_revision: Second Revision, February 2024; next revision February 2027

verification.method: Occupation definition, three occupation-specific unit codes/titles and NVQ Level 4 packaging checked against official PDF pages 5-6.

notes: An occupational standard and CBT curriculum, not evidence that a named provider delivers the programme.
Competencies are limited by the source to simple single-storey buildings with shallow foundations.
Only occupation-specific units are stored; basic workplace units are omitted.
scope_verbatim: Quantity Surveying Assistant is a person who assist the Quantity Surveyor ... in respect of pre and post contract quantity surveying activities.
National Certificate at NVQ Level 4 in the occupation of Quantity Surveying Assistant will be awarded to those who are competent in units U01+ U02+ U03+ BU01+ BU02+ BU03+ BU04- F45S007Q1L4
